events.name: Elvis Week 2027: Bill Cherry & Friends with Special Guest Ginger Alden
events.info: World renown Elvis Tribute Artist, Bill Cherry, returns to the Halloran Centre for the Final Curtain Sundial Show celebrating the 50th Anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll with Special Guest, Ginger Alden on Saturday, August 14, 2027. Bill Cherry won the Ultimate Elvis Tribute Artist Contest Championship. Since then, he has toured all over the world paying tribute to the King of Rock and Roll. Many claim that Cherry is the best in the business at honoring the legacy of the greatest entertainer of all time. Ginger Alden met Elvis Presley in late 1976, when her sister was Miss Tennessee and was invited to Graceland. Elvis was immediately taken by Ginger, and they started a romance that lasted until his untimely death in August 1977. In January of 1977, Elvis had his jeweler remove the large diamond from his famous TCB ring and craft an engagement ring for Ginger. Upstairs at Graceland, Elvis proposed marriage to Ginger, and she accepted.
